source: NOAA NHC GIS (KMZ) + Tropical Weather Outlook

outlook.discussion: 1. Subtropical Central Atlantic: A trough of low pressure located several hundred miles east of Bermuda is producing a large area of disorganized showers and thunderstorms. Further development of this system is not expected as it moves north-northeastward into increasingly unfavorable environmental conditions during the next day or so. Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...low...near 0 percent.

1. Western Central Pacific: An area of low pressure is forecast to form near the International Date Line, several hundred miles west of Johnston Atoll late this weekend or early next week. Environmental conditions could support some slow development thereafter while the system moves generally eastward to east-northeastward. Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
